evals.prompt: I have a React design system with Storybook and I want to add an MCP server so Claude can query my components. My components are in src/components/ following the pattern ComponentName/ComponentName.tsx with _stories/ and _docs/ subdirectories. I deploy on Netlify. Can you set this up for me?
evals.expected_output: Should scaffold complete MCP server: scripts/build-mcp-metadata.ts, mcp/ directory with tools/, netlify/functions/mcp.mts, update package.json with dependencies and build script

evals.prompt: I already have the MCP server set up in my design system repo. Now I want to add a new tool that searches for components by prop name. For example, I want to find all components that have a 'variant' prop. Can you help me create this tool?
evals.expected_output: Should create new tool file mcp/tools/search-by-prop.ts with proper Zod schema, handler logic that filters components by prop name, and update mcp/tools/index.ts to register it

evals.prompt: Help me add an MCP server to my design system. I use Vercel for deployment. My tokens are in src/design-tokens/ not src/tokens/. Will this work with your setup?
evals.expected_output: Should explain the enforced structure requirement, potentially offer to adapt the metadata extraction, and scaffold Vercel deployment entry point (api/mcp.ts)
